BiblicalUsage: Hanachah is a release, a rest from burdens, and it appears once, in the feast the king makes for Esther. In Esther 2:18 Ahasuerus makes a release to the provinces and gives gifts with royal bounty, lifting the load off his people for the day.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a true king knows how to give his people rest, and this small release points to the greater one Esther will win for them all.
